svg.title: A pure Kotlin project omits the common root package from its directory structure
svg.desc: For the class com.acme.billing.invoice.pdf.Renderer, a pure Kotlin project puts the file at invoice/pdf/Renderer.kt under the source root, omitting the com/acme/billing root package directories. A mixed Kotlin and Java project instead mirrors the full package path, com/acme/billing/invoice/pdf/Renderer.kt, the same layout Java itself uses.
svg.text: The common root package (com/acme/billing) is omitted only in a pure Kotlin project.
